text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 6 years of experience, and I’d be excited to help you turn data into clear insights that support better business decisions. I’m comfortable working across the full analytics workflow, from acquiring and organizing data to analyzing patterns, building reliable data systems, and presenting results in a way that is practical and easy to act on.

My background includes Python, machine learning, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, NLP, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and the OpenAI API. I’m especially focused on using data responsibly and systematically, and I understand the value of accurate reporting, strong data quality, and repeatable analysis when supporting decision-making. I can help interpret data, identify trends and patterns in complex datasets, and develop analytics workflows that improve efficiency and consistency.

One relevant project I can share is a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier in Python and scikit-learn that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, with the system served by FastAPI and retraining handled through a Celery worker on Redis. The model achieved a macro-F1 of 0.88 compared with 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and it reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That project reflects the kind of structured, results-oriented work I bring to data problems: identifying what matters in the data, building a dependable process, and delivering measurable improvement.

For this role, I would be glad to support ongoing reporting, data collection and database-related workflows, and analysis that helps uncover meaningful trends in your data. I work carefully, communicate clearly, and aim to produce outputs that are both technically sound and useful to stakeholders.

If you’re looking for someone who is passionate, dependable, and able to turn data into insight, I’d welcome the opportunity to contribute.
